component.name: DL Prism Desktop
component.summary: Desktop control tower for the DL Prism gateway

description.p: DL Prism is a local-first AI gateway: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of every model you use, cloud or local, with manual and automatic routing, policy rules, failover and budget-aware cost tracking.
This app starts and stops the gateway (included), shows its health, spend against budget and providers, connects cloud providers and manages local Ollama models. The dashboard opens in your browser.
